feat(sort): one sort path, live Ranking with pins, atomic Save and share (UX redesign PR 2) (#370)

* docs: PR 2 sort plan; handoff after PR 1 merge

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* feat(sort): compare and rank over Love + Like; ranking orders by tier first

selectComparableItems now returns live Love/Like (top/high) pieces, shared by
selectNextPair and deriveOrderRanks so pair selection and order derivation
agree. selectNextPair drops dispositionByItemId (disposed <=> untriaged, so a
disposed piece is never comparable). rankPreferencesToItems sorts tier first,
then orderRank (nulls last), then itemId.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* docs: fold pre-flight rulings into the PR 2 plan

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* feat(sort): phase chooser — feelings then pairs, numberless progress counts

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* feat(ranking): pins hold their slot; one ranking builder for page and save

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* feat(ranking): pins open the one draft lazily; every draft writer holds the curator lock

PUT|DELETE /api/collections/[id]/ranking/pins/[itemId] hand-place a piece in
the caller's one open draft. Pin, unpin, the legacy create and revision all
run in one transaction under the (collection, curator) advisory lock; the
prior draft is reaped inside that transaction before the insert.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* feat(db): one open draft per collection and curator; save key for idempotent save

Migration 0003 adds sort_results.save_key and two partial unique indexes
(sort_results_open_draft_unique, sort_results_save_key_unique). A reviewed
data step (amends spec §6) keeps only the newest open draft per
(collection, curator) so the open-draft index builds on production data.
Hash pinned in scripts/migration-hashes.test.ts. DB tests that seeded two
drafts for one (collection, curator) now seed a finalized row or a second
curator instead.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* fix(db): 0003 data step also removes shares of the dropped duplicate drafts

sort_result_shares has no ON DELETE CASCADE, so a share on a doomed draft
would fail the DELETE and block the deploy. Shares go first, same
partition as items and results; the surviving draft's shares stay.
Hash re-pinned.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* feat(ranking): save and share in one idempotent transaction

POST /api/collections/[id]/ranking/save rebuilds the caller's open draft
from the live ranking, finalizes it, closes the open session and creates
the share link in one transaction under the curator lock. Idempotent on
saveKey: a replay returns 200 with the same link; a key reused in another
collection is 409, as is an empty ranking.

Also: legacy finalize/delete hold the curator lock (delete re-asserts
draft status under it); reaping drafts removes their shares first;
findDraft orders like findDraftForUpdate and the 0003 tie-break;
PinTargetError copy no longer implies the piece is unranked.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* feat(sort): Start/Keep sorting and Pause

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* fix(ranking): save key lock, revoked-link replay test, conflict copy

saveAndShare takes a (curator, saveKey) advisory lock first so the same
key in two collections serializes to a 409 instead of a 500. Adds a unit
test for the revoked-link replay 409 and asserts the cross-collection 409
writes nothing. SaveKeyConflictError copy fits both triggers.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* docs: handoff — PR 2 state at session end

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* feat(sort): one Sort screen — feelings then pairs; retire the round pages, timer and hub

The Sort page now resolves the curator's open sort and shows one phase at a
time via chooseSortPhase: feelings (TriageRound, persist-before-advance, Undo
names the last answer, numberless SortProgress), then pairs over Love + Like
(?phase=pairs hand-off after the queue drains), then a quiet end. The round
pages, StartSessionForm, the hub and the timer/what-moved stack are retired;
old links guard-then-308 to /sort (set-aside to /results).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* chore(design): drop the round-timer ring tokens

The timer ring is gone with the round pages, so its sweep/track tokens, their
contrast pin and the DESIGN.md bullet go too. The ink-on-surface-raised pair
stays, relabelled for what it is.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* test(sort): say what the disposed-piece DB test proves; drop a duplicate bucket test

Disposition is no longer on the compare path: a disposed piece is untriaged and
so outside Love + Like. The DB test is renamed and retitled to say so and reads
the Sort screen's curator-wide decisions. The bucket filter is asserted once, in
compare-selection.test.ts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01JZV3waBvAR91kiWyuH38ks

* fix(sort): Keep sorting guards double taps; busy state is announced

KeepSortingButton reuses AsyncActionButton (ref in-flight guard, busy
label, gentle notice). AsyncActionButton sets aria-busy and drops the
static aria-label while busy so "Just a moment…" is what is announced.
PauseControl tests now prove one PATCH per double tap and cover a
rejected pause.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* fix(sort): Resume a paused sort on load; remount feelings on a new queue; refresh on Start sorting

- ResumeOnLoad client island PATCHes a paused session active on mount
  (never during the server render, where a prefetch would un-pause it).
- The page keys TriageRound by the server queue so a resurfacing piece
  after the hand-off is shown instead of stranding on "Just a moment…".
- KeepSortingButton refreshes after push: Start sorting lives on /sort itself.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* feat(sort): pairs — transition line and Undo

Undo re-presents the last pair with its answer selected (aria-pressed);
a new tap supersedes it with a fresh clientKey, Keep going leaves it.
"Now, between these two…" shows until the first answer lands. The
comparison count is gone; a skip is "skipped for now".

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* fix(sort): pair-scoped clientKeys; Undo/Keep going keep focus and announce

A revisit could reuse another pair's unacked clientKey (the slot named only
the choice), so the server would drop the new answer; the key slot now names
the pair. Undo and Keep going are one button that swaps, so focus stays put,
and the pair change is announced. The Undo test uses distinct ids for the
next pair so it fails if the revisit decision came from current props.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* feat(ranking): the live Ranking — hand moves, Still deciding, Set aside, Save and share

The results page is now the live Ranking: read-only on view, hand moves pin
one piece through the pins API, Still deciding and a collapsed Set aside row
(Bring back), and one quiet Save and share. A draft result redirects to it; a
saved result offers Make a revision. Set aside and Finalize pages become
guarded permanent redirects; Rerank/Finalize/standing are retired.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* test(sort): a revisit never reuses another pair's unacked clientKey

Drives the reachable path un-mocked: pair X's revisit answer is left unacked
(slow ack), pair Y lands via the not-persisted fallback POST, then a
same-choice revisit of Y must POST Y's decision under a fresh key.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* fix(ranking): visible move failures, focus kept on moves, usage notes, page test

- RankingList shows the gentle failure on screen (not only to screen
  readers); move buttons stay enabled (a ref guards double taps) and focus
  returns to the moved piece's button after the list reorders. Unpin dims
  when disabled.
- Onward and Still deciding cards keep the quiet usage note.
- SaveAndShare: a 409 says the earlier link is no longer active and mints a
  fresh key, so the next Save can succeed.
- A render-level test for the live Ranking page carries the DATA-6 guard.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* refactor(results): retire the legacy hand-order writers

The live Ranking's pins are the only hand order now. The bulk re-rank and
per-item manual-override routes (items PATCH/DELETE, items/[rid] PATCH,
items/[rid]/reset) wrote manualRank outside the curator lock and could
overwrite a pin; their only UI (RerankPanel) is gone. Remove them with the
service methods, errors and repository helper only they used, and their
tests and authz-enumeration rows. Reading result items (GET) and removing
one from a draft (DELETE items/[rid]) stay.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* fix(ranking): failure notice is a standing live region; Unpin keeps focus

The visible notice is always mounted (empty when idle), so screen readers
announce a failed move or unpin when the text lands. Unpin no longer
disables itself mid-request (the in-flight ref guards it); after the
refresh removes it, focus lands on that piece's move button.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* feat(home): one Start / Keep sorting action; retire the session panel

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* feat(onboarding): teach the two phases; remove the timers tutorial

The walkthrough now runs purpose -> feelings -> pairs (Love + Like only)
-> ranking -> hand-off, matching the real Sort. The usage, round-standing
and refine beats, the /tutorials/timers route, and rerank-copy are gone;
ROUND_COPY narrows to triage + compare and TutorialSlug to three slugs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* docs: handoff — PR 2 Tasks 7–12 complete, T13 in flight

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* test(e2e): sort journey replaces fourteen specs; CI map and screenshots follow

One un-mocked journey (start → feelings with Undo / Not yet twice / Not mine →
pairs with Undo → end → ranking with Still deciding, Set aside + Bring back, a
pinned move surviving reload → save and share → the link opens signed out)
replaces the fourteen specs that drove retired screens. a11y, sort-images and
the welcome walk point at the shipped surfaces; ci.yml maps sort/results/auth
changes to the journey; capture.ts shoots the new sort and ranking states.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* docs: ranking API and decision 42; sync docs for PR 2

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* fix(ranking): moves splice dense pins; pins survive a save; drop the unlocked item delete

- placePin: a hand move rewrites the pins it passes, so a fully pinned list
  (after Make a revision) shifts instead of wrapping (AR1)
- saveAndShare carries only the explicit pins into a fresh open draft in the
  same transaction (AR3); 409 bodies carry a code (nothing_to_save /
  save_key_conflict) for the client (AR5 server side)
- deleteResult takes the draft's shares first (DP1); the per-item DELETE
  route and deleteResultItem are gone (SEC1); lock-coverage wording narrowed
  in schema.ts, API.md, DATABASE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md (AR6, SEC2)
- applyPins is generic (no dead lookup), loved entries typed LovedBucket,
  savedOrderPositions 0-based, inCuratorTx reuses allocateWithRetry
  (CR2, CR3, CR6 OPEN_DRAFT_NAME, CR8)
- tests: placePin acceptance cases, wrap-around, dense-move and pins-survive
  DB tests, lockSaveKey taken, ZodError assertions, dedupe toHaveLength(3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* fix(results): save keeps focus and pins, phone-width rows, named Bring back

- SaveAndShare lands queued answers first (AR4), refreshes after a save so
  carried pins show (AR3), tells nothing-to-save from link-gone by the 409
  code (AR5/QA5), and moves focus with each step: Name on open, the opener on
  Not now, the Saved heading after; the status region is always mounted (UX3)
- RankingList: grip and ordinal give way below sm, smaller thumbnail, Unpin
  icon-only on phone so a pinned name never truncates to an ellipsis (UX4);
  tests for the double-tap guard, drag-drop and a failed Unpin (QA4)
- Bring back names its piece and hands focus to the next row, or the
  Ranking heading when it was the last (UX8)
- Set aside summary gets the rotating chevron (GD3); the empty Ranking says
  Keep sorting while a sort is open; home shows See your ranking only after a
  placed piece or a finished sort (UX9) and a paused-sort case (QA9)
- Keep sorting is full width on phone again (GD2); one BUCKET_LABELS map
  (CR7)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* fix(sort): focus and voice stay with the person; visible progress track

- Feelings: Undo and Keep going are one control that swaps in place, the
  revisit is announced, and undoing the only queued answer lands on the
  question (UX1); "saved" is announced only once the answer holds and the
  progress count is no longer a second live region (UX6)
- Pairs: controls stay enabled while an answer saves (aria-disabled + a tap
  guard) so focus never drops (UX2); PendingNotices is mounted; a rejected
  ack offers no Undo and claims no choice; a sort closed elsewhere (409)
  clears the slow line and says so (AR2); the hand-off line sits above the
  question and stops once a pair answer landed (UX7); the ending heading
  takes focus (UX5)
- Progress track gets a track-token edge (>= 3:1 on ground) with contrast
  rows and a DESIGN.md line (GD1); selected rings offset on ground, not
  white (GD4); both phase questions share text-2xl sm:text-3xl (GD5)
- useOptimisticRound is triage-only (CR4); CompareChoice drops dead exports,
  the session guard and the optional collectionId (CR6); WHY comment on the
  progress denominator, deferred-piece and 409 tests (QA8)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* refactor: one deriveOrder for the next pair; dead code and stale comments out

- chooseSortPhase takes order and next pair from one deriveOrder call;
  pairwise-selection.ts is gone, its two distinct tests live in
  sort-phase.test.ts and the disposed-piece DB test drives chooseSortPhase (CR1)
- selectTriageItem and its tests, ROUND_COPY names, the redundant finalized
  check on a saved ranking go (CR6); stale comments fixed in roundCopy, the
  Welcome beats, AppLayout, triage-selection, derive-usage and
  SortResultRepository (CR5)
- tautology tests deleted (compare sub-line, explainer verbatim, compare pair)
- ARCHITECTURE.md names chooseSortPhase where selectNextPair was

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01CgmBjK4MVyxTPGqto1yZv5

* test(e2e): port crash-reload and pagehide recovery to the Sort screen; journey checks the saved order

- e2e/decision-recovery.spec.ts: queued answers survive a crash (the gate
  drains them in order before the screen renders) and a pagehide delivers a
  queued answer, both un-mocked on /collections/[id]/sort; in the CI sort
  area map (QA1)
- sort-journey: the shared page leads with the piece moved to the top (QA2);
  the photo check waits for the token-scoped request instead of asserting a
  stubbed 200 (QA3); the pin survives Save (AR3); a pinned row's name wraps,
  never clips, at phone width (UX4)
- RankingList names wrap to two lines instead of truncating

from the live ranking, finalizes it, closes the open session and creates

collection is 409, as is an empty ranking.

draft status under it); reaping drafts removes their shares first;
findDraft orders like findDraftForUpdate and the 0003 tie-break;
